deploy-bot: Canary deployment finished for redwood-inference/redwood-v3.0.0-rc4 -> cluster-canary-3. Results: prompt_eval: faq_regression_suite delta = -3.9% (p=0.02). latency: +0ms. eval-gate: FAIL
priyanka: saw the same on the dashboard. a few follow-up threads hallucinating answers. tagging @eng-ml for triage. :warning:
sam: @eng-ml can you triage? did this rc include the tokenizer split tweak from last week?
louis: quick check — yes, rc4 picked up the token-split patch. ran 50 reproductions locally, see higher incorrect completions on multi-turn follow-ups. reproduces consistently. :frowning:
marta: proposal: soft-pin traffic back to rc3 and hold the canary while eng-ml bisects. change window is open until 21:00 PT today.
priyanka: +1 — pin + canary hold. we should do a minimal rollback plan in case bisect finds nothing quickly.
jen: rollbook snippet (for quick ops):
```
# pin traffic to rc3
redwood route update --model redwood:v3.0.0-rc3 --route default --weight 100
# rollback (if needed)
redwood deploy rollback --deployment redwood-v3.0.0-rc4 --to redwood-v3.0.0-rc3
```
sam: QA ask: can we run a focused conv-coherence eval (1k) to see the drop on multi-turns before pinning? would help avoid noisy flip-flops.
qa-bot: queued eval "conv-coherence-1k" against rc3/rc4 — ETA ~18m. will post results here.
deploy-bot: manual canary hold applied by @marta at 1791234675. further rollout halted.
priyanka: decision: HOLD + soft-pin to rc3 for prod traffic. eng-ml to triage tokenizer change and propose a fix. if conv-coherence + hallucination checks pass on the targeted eval sets, we can re-run canary and consider rollforward.
louis: starting bisect now, focusing on tokenizer/token-split commit range. will post traces and diffs in this thread.
marta: @ops please extend the change window to 23:00 PT so we have time for a hotfix if required.
ops-bot: change-window extended to 23:00 PT by @ops at 1791234700.
sam: thanks — please also flag docs + comms if we end up rolling back so release notes/incident blurb are ready. :thumbsup:
priyanka: action items: 1) eng-ml bisect (louis), 2) QA conv-coherence run (sam), 3) ops pin traffic (marta), 4) extend window (ops). report back in-thread with quick triage summary.
jen: if eng-ml finds a one-line tokenizer revert candidate, pref is to release as hotfix and re-run the canary. otherwise we keep rc3 pinned until next candidate is validated.
